allergens_page_intro: Full allergen and ingredient information for all GOTERA products, provided in accordance with the UK Food Information to Consumers Regulation (FIC) and Natasha's Law.
allergens_legal_notice: If you have a food allergy or intolerance, please read all allergen information carefully before ordering. If you are unsure whether a product is safe for you, contact us before placing an order. Do not rely on product descriptions alone — always check the full ingredient and allergen information below.
allergens_injera_ingredients_list: Teff Flour (100%), Water, Live Fermentation Culture.
allergens_injera_gluten_free_desc: This product is made using a recipe with no gluten-containing ingredients. Teff is a naturally gluten-free grain.
allergens_item_gluten_subtext: wheat, rye, barley, oats, spelt, kamut
allergens_item_gluten_notes: Recipe contains no gluten-containing grains. Made with 100% teff.
allergens_item_soybeans_notes: Produced in a facility that also handles soy products.
allergens_item_milk_notes: Product is vegan. No dairy ingredients used.
allergens_item_nuts_subtext: almond, hazelnut, walnut, cashew, pecan, brazil, pistachio, macadamia
allergens_item_nuts_notes: Produced in a facility that also handles tree nuts.
allergens_cross_text: GOTERA injera is produced in a facility in Ethiopia that also handles soy and tree nuts. While production lines are cleaned between runs, we cannot guarantee the complete absence of these allergens in the final product. Customers with severe allergies to soy or tree nuts should consider this risk carefully before ordering.
allergens_cert_text: GOTERA injera is made from 100% teff flour — a naturally gluten-free grain native to Ethiopia. No wheat, rye, barley, oats, spelt, or kamut are used in the recipe. This claim refers to the recipe ingredients only. Customers with coeliac disease should note the cross-contamination statement above and consult their healthcare provider if unsure.
allergens_addons_intro: Full allergen information for each add-on product is provided on the individual product label and will be listed here as each product launches. If you have a specific allergy query about an add-on product, contact us before ordering.
allergens_addons_placeholder: Add-on allergen information will be published here before each product is made available to order.
allergens_contact_text: If you have a food allergy or intolerance and need more information before ordering, contact us directly. We will respond within one business day.
allergens_regulatory_note: Allergen information is provided in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 as retained in UK law, and Natasha's Law (UK Food Information Amendment 2019), which came into force 1 October 2021. The 14 allergens listed above are those required to be declared under UK food law. This information was last reviewed March 2026. GOTERA Foods Ltd reserves the right to update ingredient and allergen information as formulations or suppliers change — please check this page before each order if you have a food allergy.

faq_hero_subtitle: Everything you need to know before subscribing — and after.
faq_cta_subtitle: No minimum term. Cancel any time. Start with one pack if you're not sure.
faq_cta_contact_suffix: — we respond within one working day.
faq_product_q1_answer: Injera is a naturally fermented Ethiopian flatbread made from teff — a small, nutrient-dense grain native to the Horn of Africa. It has a distinctive spongy texture and a mild, slightly sour flavour from the fermentation process. It is the foundation of Ethiopian and Eritrean cuisine, used both as a plate and as a utensil.
faq_product_q2_answer: Made and packed in Ethiopia. We keep the product at its source — that is what makes it real.
faq_product_q3_answer: Yes. GOTERA injera is made from 100% teff, which is naturally gluten-free. It is also vegan and high in iron. If you have a severe gluten intolerance or coeliac disease, please check the packaging for full allergen information once you receive your order.
faq_product_q4_question: How fresh is the injera when it arrives?
faq_product_q4_answer: Each order is packed on dispatch day and shipped in insulated cold-chain packaging. It arrives at the correct temperature and carries a best-before date on the pack. You should consume it before that date.
faq_product_q5_answer: Yes. Injera freezes well. Separate individual pieces with baking paper before freezing, and defrost at room temperature. Full storage guidance is printed on the packaging.
faq_product_q6_question: What if I don't like it?
faq_product_q6_answer: If a product arrives damaged or is not what you ordered, contact us within 48 hours at hello@gotera.co.uk and we will sort it. Food products cannot be returned, but we will always make it right if something has gone wrong on our side.
faq_subscription_q1_answer: You choose a plan, we deliver injera once a month. Payment is taken automatically on the same date each month. You manage everything — pausing, skipping, changing plan, adding products — from your account.
faq_subscription_q2_answer: None. Cancel any time from your account. No cancellation fees.
faq_subscription_q3_answer: Account → Cancel Subscription. Your subscription ends at the close of the current billing period. You won't be charged again after that. You can also email hello@gotera.co.uk.
faq_subscription_q4_question: Can I pause or skip a delivery?
faq_subscription_q4_answer: Yes. Pause your subscription entirely with no time limit, or skip a single month's delivery — both from your account. Changes must be made before the cut-off date for the upcoming delivery, shown in your account.
faq_subscription_q5_answer: Yes. Switch between Starter (2 packs, £12/month) and Regular (4 packs, £24/month) any time from your account. Changes take effect from the next billing cycle.
faq_subscription_q6_answer: Pantry products — currently Berbere (£3.50), Mitmita (£3.50), and Niter Kibbeh (£5.00) — that you can add to any monthly delivery. Select them from your account before the cut-off date. They are added to that month's payment.
faq_delivery_q1_answer: London only at launch. We are expanding to other UK cities in 2026. Email hello@gotera.co.uk to register interest for your area.
faq_delivery_q2_answer: Saturdays, between 8am and 6pm. You'll receive a notification with a tighter window on the morning of your delivery.
faq_delivery_q3_answer: The Sunday before your Saturday delivery at midnight. Changes — add-ons, address updates, skips — made after the cut-off apply to the following month. Your exact cut-off is shown in your account.
faq_delivery_q4_answer: Set a safe place in your account and we'll leave your order there. If no safe place is set and you're not home, we'll leave a card with instructions. Temperature-sensitive orders won't be left in locations exposed to heat.
faq_delivery_q5_question: My order hasn't arrived. What do I do?
faq_delivery_q5_answer: Contact us within 48 hours at hello@gotera.co.uk. We respond within 4 hours on delivery days. Confirmed lost orders get a replacement or account credit. Full details on the Delivery page.
faq_gifting_q1_question: How does a gift order work?
faq_gifting_q1_answer: Choose a gift size (single or double pack), add any pantry extras, enter the recipient's address, and pay once. No subscription is created for the recipient. A confirmation goes to your email.
faq_gifting_q2_answer: Yes. There is a message field in the gift checkout. Keep it short — it will be included with the order.
faq_gifting_q3_question: Does the recipient need a GOTERA account?
faq_gifting_q3_answer: No. A gift is a one-time order. The recipient does not need an account and is not signed up to any subscription.
faq_account_q1_question: How do I update my delivery address?
faq_account_q1_answer: Account → Your Details → Update Address. Changes before the cut-off apply to the next delivery. Changes after the cut-off apply the following month.
faq_account_q2_question: How do I update my payment method?
faq_account_q2_answer: Account → Payment → Update Payment. Your new card is saved and used for all future billing.
faq_account_q3_question: I forgot my password. What do I do?
faq_account_q3_answer: Use the "Forgot your password?" link on the sign in page. A reset link will be sent to your registered email address.

terms_service_content: GOTERA is a premium Ethiopian food subscription service. We supply injera and related pantry products monthly. Products are made and packed in Ethiopia, distributed in the UK. We currently deliver within London only.
terms_subscription_billing_body: Subscriptions bill monthly on the same date as first payment. You will receive an email before each charge. The amount reflects your plan plus any add-ons.
terms_subscription_cancellation_body: Cancel any time from your account. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. No refunds for payments already taken.
terms_subscription_pause_body: Pause or skip a delivery from your account before the cut-off date.
terms_pricing_content: All prices in GBP, inclusive of VAT where applicable. Price changes notified 30 days in advance. Payments processed by Stripe — we do not store card details. Failed payments are retried once after 3 days.
terms_delivery_content: London only. Saturdays. Cold-chain packaging. Full details at Delivery. If delivery is lost in transit, contact us within 48 hours.
terms_refunds_content: Food products cannot be returned. If a product arrives damaged or incorrect, contact us within 48 hours with a photo at hello@gotera.co.uk. We will offer a replacement, credit, or refund as appropriate. Statutory rights under the Consumer Rights Act 2015 are not affected.
terms_quality_content: All injera is 100% teff, naturally fermented, vegan, and gluten-free. Consume before the best-before date. Quality complaints responded to within 3 working days.
terms_liability_content: Our liability is limited to the amount paid for the product in question. We are not liable for indirect or consequential losses. Your statutory consumer rights are not limited.
terms_law_content: These terms are governed by the law of England and Wales.

subterms_failedpay_body: If payment fails we email you immediately and retry after 3 days. If the second attempt fails, we email again. After 7 days without resolution, your subscription is paused — no delivery is made for that cycle. Update payment at Account → Payment.

origin_paragraph1: GOTERA works directly with producers in Ethiopia who have been making injera for generations. The teff is grown in the Ethiopian highlands. The fermentation uses a live culture passed down through families.
origin_paragraph2: We do not import Teff and manufacture it elsewhere. We source the real thing at its origin, exactly as it should be, and bring it to London by cold chain.
origin_statement_line3: Taste the difference real Teff makes
final_sub: Stop searching. Start enjoying real Ethiopian injera delivered to your door every Saturday.
truth_heading: Let's be honest about the injera you're buying right now.
truth_point2: Finding it means driving across town.
truth_point3: What's on the shelf is often wheat, not teff.
truth_point4: It doesn't taste right. It doesn't feel right.
truth_point5: By the time you find it, it's already gone stale and spoiled.
truth_resolve_lead: Real injera shouldn't be this hard to find.
truth_resolve_sub: So we brought it here, made properly.
